fields.label: Reference Doctype
fields.description: Which doctype this config restricts — e.g. Farm, Asset. One config record per doctype; upsert_feature only enforces a restriction for doctypes that have a config row here, so every other doctype is unaffected.

fields.label: Allowed Geometries
fields.description: Which (geometry type, feature role) combinations are valid for this doctype — e.g. Asset might allow Point/Location, LineString/Alignment, and Polygon/Footprint all at once. Leave empty to allow anything for this doctype (same as having no config row at all).
